title: GitOps-Backed React Portfolio
description: A modular, Git-backed React portfolio automatically deployed via GitHub Actions...
details: Instead of a simple static site, I engineered a serverless headless CMS driven entirely by GitOps principles. To eliminate the need for a traditional SQL database, I built a bespoke Admin panel that acts as a pipeline trigger. It uses the GitHub REST API to commit raw Markdown directly to version control. This commit triggers a highly optimized GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline (tuned with dependency caching to deploy in under 30 seconds). Media assets are decoupled into a secondary repository acting as a CDN to prevent codebase bloat. The next phase of this project is migrating the hosting from GitHub Pages to a custom AWS VPC and EKS cluster provisioned via Terraform and monitored by CloudWatch, grafana, and other observability tools.
